title: No sound, or the wrong sound
summary: Check focus, the audio device, muted tracks and the Signal Lab's status line when nothing plays.
alternateQueries: Why can I not hear anything?
Why is the Signal Lab making noise?

blocks.title: Pressing Play makes no sound
symptoms: Play highlights but nothing is heard
the Tracker plays nothing while the Signal Lab is showing
blocks.resolution: Play goes to the panel that has focus. Click into the panel you want to hear (the Tracker for the arrangement, the Signal Lab for the sound you are designing) and press Play again.
blocks.cause: The transport plays whichever of the Tracker or the Signal Lab has focus.

blocks.title: Nothing is heard from anything
blocks.resolution: Click Audio in the header and choose your output device. Check the master volume and that the track is not muted or another track soloed.

blocks.title: Signal Lab: read the status line
blocks.resolution: After you press Play, the line under the panel title says either "Playing live: N source(s), M wire(s)" or "Play did not start the live engine (...)". If it says 0 sources, place an oscillator and wire it to the Sink. If it says playing, check the device and levels as above.

blocks.title: Signal Lab was silent or noisy until a track existed
symptoms: Signal Lab noise or silence with no tracks in the Tracker
sound appears after adding a track
blocks.resolution: Update to Djehuti Station 0.9.1 Beta 6 or later. In earlier betas the Signal Lab needed a track on the Tracker to play cleanly.
blocks.cause: Fixed in Beta 6: the live signal now clears its own output space and no longer depends on a track.
